messages:
sam: heads-up: ap-southeast canary failing with ImagePullBackOff after chart upgrade.
laura: error?
sam: from pod: `ErrImagePull: manifest for registry.ap-southeast.example.com/redis:2026-03-22 not found`
alex: chart bumped image.tag -> 2026-03-22 in chart v2.4.1 but regional promotion didn't finish. imagePullPolicy=Always so it tries to pull and fails.
ci-bot: Promotion pipeline shows global push succeeded but regional sync job failed in ap-southeast (timeout).
sam: deploy-bot already marked canary unhealthy and stopped the rollout. @deploy-bot status?
deploy-bot: Canary 3112345678-ap-southeast paused due to ImagePullBackOff. Action: hold and notify release-ops.
laura: options: 1) rollback chart in region, 2) pin image to working digest from prod (manual override), 3) re-run regional registry sync and re-push image. Change window is 20m.
alex: rolling back will revert fixes in chart v2.4.1 (we prefer to keep them). pinning to digest is low-risk and quick.
release-ops: decision needed now. Is there a known stable digest we can pin to?
laura: yes — prod currently running digest sha256:abcdef123456. I can push an overrides file and queue a regional hotpatch. Command: `deploy-bot promote --env ap-southeast --overrides overrides/ap-seal-pin.yaml --annotate "temp-image-pin-apse"` where overrides sets `image.digest=sha256:abcdef123456` and `image.pullPolicy=IfNotPresent`.
sam: do it and tag me; I'll run canary smoke once it's up.
laura: queued job 3112345690. Adding release annotation `temp-image-pin-apse` and note in release metadata: `temp-unpin-ETA=3112348278`.
deploy-bot: Queued job 3112345690 by laura. Running preflight -> helm upgrade with overrides -> waiting for pods. ETA ~1m.
ci-bot: started registry sync retry for ap-southeast in background (job 3112345692) but we'll still proceed with pin to unblock.
sam: pods coming up, logs look normal. smoke tests running.
ci-bot: smoke checks passed. Canary healthy after pin. :thumbsup:
release-ops: recording decision: apply temporary image digest pin in ap-southeast; do not rollback chart. Follow-up action: re-run regional registry sync and then remove pin in 45m during next quiet window.
alex: will add a note to the release draft under Known Issues: "ap-southeast temporary image pin due to regional registry sync failure; will unpin after sync completes."
laura: creating a short PR to add a gating step to the image promotion pipeline: require regional manifest availability before global chart promotion.
sam: thanks. Also add a checklist item to ensure image.tag -> digest mapping is validated in preflight for future releases.
release-ops: logged action items and closed the incident for now.
